structured_output.summary: This finding was about a missing test, so I added one test and changed no code. The new file is tests/game/pine-ridge-menu-return.test.ts. It starts with empty storage, finishes a race on Hay Loop and then on Dust Bowl, and clicks NEXT RACE, which starts forest-ridge. Then it presses Escape, clicks QUIT TO MENU, checks that the selected card is Pine Ridge, and clicks RACE to check that forest-ridge starts. This goes through select('forest-ridge') on a card the menu still marks locked because the menu hasn't shown since the unlock. Red/green: I deleted the re-read in select() (`if (card) card.setLocked(locked(trackId));`, start-screen.ts:112) and the test failed with "expected 'Bramble BendsBEST –:––.––' to contain 'Pine Ridge'". With the line put back it passes. The repo has no git here, so I restored the line by hand and checked it. pnpm typecheck passes, and pnpm test passes: 149 files, 856 tests.
